LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

   D. Copy random text without understanding Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Features of prose fiction - The Author - The plot - .
